title: Black Eagles Comparison
prompt:
Slow controlled push-in across the academy courtyard. Edelgard remains composed in the foreground while Hubert stands slightly behind like a quiet shadow. Background students cross softly out of focus. Keep the mood political and restrained, with no overt threat. Minimal facial movement: Edelgard watches, Hubert observes.

Camera: slow push-in, long lens, stable.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: villain posing, sudden gestures, war costumes, text. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
